faq: Do I keep my existing content?
Yes. Text, images, page names and settings carry over, and only the look changes. We note how the site looked before we start, so there is always a point to compare against.
Can I keep my template but change how it looks?
Yes. Squarespace lets you restyle fonts, colors, spacing and layouts without changing templates. For very large changes we suggest a fresh start on a new layout and explain why.
Will the redesign affect my SEO?
We aim to protect it by keeping page addresses, headings and titles, and redirecting anything that moves. A fresh, faster layout can help visitors too. We cannot promise rankings.
Do you create new photos or a logo?
No. We use what you provide and resize it. A new logo or photography is a separate job. We can place new files you supply, and we flag weak images in the handover.
